Detect creation of local HTTP servers on non-standard ports (e.g., 3004) and monitor for command execution via HTTP query parameters. Identify dynamic download and execution of binaries, especially when triggered by hidden or obfuscated logic. Look for the presence of suspicious lock files or temporary executables (e.g., node.compress.exe, node.compress.lock.log). Network monitoring should alert on unexpected local HTTP servers and outbound requests to untrusted or attacker-controlled domains.
